description: Ratio of ATM-strike combined OI to total nearby-strike OI. Intuition: heavy concentration at one strike may indicate dealer/institutional pinning around that level, which COULD suppress near-term movement. EXPERIMENTAL.
predicts: High concentration (top 20% of observed values) predicts the price stays within 0.3% of its current level for the next 20 cycles (range-bound).

result.reason: Does not beat naive baseline meaningfully (improvement -79.1%, precision 0.993). No evidence this metric adds predictive value over guessing the majority outcome.
